notes: Read tools are seedless and call the public desk.
Buy tools do not accept a seed argument. The operator environment holds WALKIN_BUYER_SEED or XRPL_BUYER_SEED, or the command uses --faucet.
Signing happens in src/walk-in-buy.js and src/x402-pay.js. The desk never calls Wallet.sign.
Refuse mainnet hosts and NetworkID 0. Refuse CI and GITHUB_ACTIONS on any signing path.

tools.name: walk_in_status
tools.description: Read the current Walk-In Window sell offer on XRPL Testnet. Returns open or sold_out plus the live OfferID. Does not sign.

tools.name: walk_in_buy
tools.description: Accept the current W2 NFT sell offer from a non-Foundry Testnet wallet. Signing is delegated to npm run buy:walk-in on the operator machine. A Foundry labeled wallet (W0-W6, AMM, BUYER, STRANGER) does not count as walk-in. Optional AETH path-pay is off unless with_aeth is true.

dry_run.description: Print the discovered offer and do not sign.

faucet.description: Fund a fresh Testnet wallet, then accept. Ignores any buyer variable already in the environment.

with_aeth.description: After the accept, TrustSet and path-pay about 50 AETH. Off by default.

offer_id.description: Optional pin. Must be an offer that is open now. Omit to take the current XRP sell offer.

record.description: Append lab/ledger-log.jsonl and a RESULTS note after tesSUCCESS. Requires a real hash.

tools.name: x402_catalog
tools.description: List desk x402 SKUs, prices in drops, and paths. Free. Testnet xrpl:1 only.

tools.name: x402_buy
tools.description: Buy a desk SKU with npm run x402:pay against the production desk. Pay-to is W3 CHANNELS. W3 must not be the buyer: that payment is circular and the script refuses it. The desk verifies a validated Payment and does not sign.

record.description: Pass --record so a real 200 appends the hit.
